t: Introduction and overview — INS Vikramaditya Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — INS Vikramaditya Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — INS Vikramaditya Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the INS Vikramaditya Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. INS Vikramaditya is India's carrier converted from the Soviet Admiral Gorshkov: rebuilt in Russia with a ski-jump and new systems, then delivered in 2013. At 45,400 tons she operates MiG-29K fighters. The conversion — years late and over budget — gave India a second carrier alongside the indigenous Vikrant. Baseline facts: Indian carrier; ex-Soviet Gorshkov rebuilt; 45,400 tons; MiG-29K; delivered 2013..
